name: Masoluv
source:
Aoi-kun is enrolled in an all girls school when his mother plays a trick on him. At that school, female activists make boys become the servants of girls!!

Of course there's sure to be mature situations in this role-reversal school!!

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE041561.html]DLSite[/url]]
translation:
葵君遭母亲捉弄，糊里糊涂地被送进了一所女子学校就读。而在那所学园里，奉行女权至上的女生们竟把男生全都当成了奴仆使唤！！

在这所男女地位彻底逆转的学园里，自然少不了各种令人面红耳赤的香艳场面！！
